amending_instruments.instrument: قرار مجلس هيئة السوق المالية رقم (2006-219-1)
amending_instruments.note_ar: الإصدار الأصلي للائحة، ومطبوع على غلاف النسخة الحالية بصيغة العرض «2006 – 219 – 1»؛ وتذكره الجريدة الرسمية وقرارات الهيئة اللاحقة بصيغة «(1-219-2006)»، وهما القرار نفسه.
amending_instruments.note_en: Original issuance. Printed on the current cover in the display order '2006 – 219 – 1'; cited by the official gazette and by CMA's own later decisions as '(1-219-2006)'. Same instrument, different display order.

amending_instruments.instrument: قرار مجلس هيئة السوق المالية رقم (2016-61-1)
amending_instruments.note_ar: تعديل مؤكَّد من غلاف نسخة الهيئة السابقة (2021) لهذه اللائحة نفسها. لم يُتَح أي مصدر يحدد المواد التي عدّلها، ولم يُسترجع أي نص سابق للتعديل.
amending_instruments.note_en: Amendment confirmed from the cover of CMA's own superseded 2021 PDF of this same instrument. No fetched source identifies which articles it amended; no pre-amendment wording was recovered.

amending_instruments.instrument: قرار مجلس هيئة السوق المالية رقم (2021-22-2)
amending_instruments.note_ar: إحلال كامل لنص اللائحة (لا مجرد تعديل جزئي)، ويُعمل به من 19/09/1442هـ الموافق 01/05/2021م، مع أحكام مرحلية اعتباراً من 28/5/1443هـ (1/1/2022م) و 8/6/1444هـ (1/1/2023م). نسخة 2021 تضم 111 مادة، مقابل 113 في النص الحالي.
amending_instruments.note_en: A FULL REPLACEMENT of the regulation's text (not a partial amendment), effective 19/09/1442H = 01/05/2021G with phased provisions from 28/5/1443H = 1/1/2022G and 8/6/1444H = 1/1/2023G. The 2021 consolidation carries 111 articles against 113 in the current text. Because of this replacement, the current wording of most articles substantially postdates 2006.

amending_instruments.instrument: قرار مجلس هيئة السوق المالية رقم (2025-54-1)
amending_instruments.note_ar: تعديل مذكور صراحةً داخل نص قرار (1-135-2025) المنشور في أم القرى بوصفه التعديل السابق لهذه اللائحة. لم يُتَح مصدر يحدد المواد التي عدّلها.
amending_instruments.note_en: Amendment expressly named inside the gazette text of decision (1-135-2025) as this regulation's immediately preceding amendment. No fetched source identifies which articles it amended.

amending_instruments.instrument: قرار مجلس هيئة السوق المالية رقم (2025-135-1)
amending_instruments.note_ar: أحدث تعديل، ومطبوع على غلاف النسخة الحالية. عدّل الفقرة (ع) من المادة الثامنة والأربعين والفقرة (ك) من المادة التاسعة والأربعين بإحلال عبارة «فئات المستثمرين المؤهلين في السوق الموازية» محل عبارة «فئات المستثمرين المؤهلين». وقد تحقّق هذا المسار من ورود العبارة المُحلّة حرفياً في الموضعين في النص المُوحَّد.
amending_instruments.note_en: The most recent amendment, printed on the current cover. Amended paragraph (ع) of Article 48 and paragraph (ك) of Article 49 by substituting «فئات المستثمرين المؤهلين في السوق الموازية» for «فئات المستثمرين المؤهلين». This track verified that the substituted phrase is present VERBATIM at both locations in the consolidated text.

verification_methodology_note:
PRIMARY SOURCE (Arabic governs): the official consolidated Arabic PDF of لائحة صناديق الاستثمار published by the Capital Market Authority on its own regulations domain -- https://cma.gov.sa/RulesRegulations/Regulations/Documents/Investment_Funds_Regulations_11_2025_AR.pdf (cma.org.sa 301-redirects to cma.gov.sa; same institution). Fetched directly this pass: HTTP 200, 1,785,182 bytes, born-digital PDF (Microsoft Word LTSC producer), 181 pages, CreationDate 2025-11-25. Reached from CMA's OWN catalogue page https://cma.gov.sa/RulesRegulations/Regulations/Pages/default.aspx, whose card for this instrument (data-title "لائحة صناديق الاستثمار", data-year 2006, data-month 12, data-category "اللوائح") links to exactly this PDF, and from CMA's own detail page https://cma.gov.sa/RulesRegulations/Regulations/Pages/details.aspx?code=99, which states "تاريخ الإصدار 2006/12/24" and "تاريخ التعديل 2025/11/26".

CITATION CHAIN -- read verbatim off the PDF's own cover page, not assumed: "لائحة صناديق الاستثمار / الصادرة عن مجلس هيئة السوق المالية بموجب القرار رقم 2006 – 219 – 1 وتاريخ 1427/12/3هـ الموافق 2006/12/24م بناءً على نظام السوق المالية الصادر بالمرسوم الملكي رقم م/30 بتاريخ 1424/6/2هـ / المعدلة بقرار مجلس هيئة السوق المالية رقم 2025-135-1 وتاريخ 1447/06/03هـ الموافق 2025/11/24م". Both decision numbers in the commissioning brief are therefore CONFIRMED. Note that CMA prints the original decision in the display order "2006 – 219 – 1" while the official gazette and CMA's own later decisions cite the same decision as "(1-219-2006)"; these are the same instrument in different display orders, and no third numbering is implied.

ARTICLE COUNT -- INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED, NOT ASSUMED. The commissioning brief reported 113 from a census. This pass re-counted from the document itself in two independent ways and got 113 both times: (1) the PDF's own table of contents (pages 2-8) lists exactly 113 numbered article entries, running an unbroken Arabic-ordinal sequence from "المادة الأولى: أحكام تمهيدية" to "المادة الثالثة عشرة بعد المئة: النشر والنفاذ"; (2) the body (from page 9) carries exactly 113 matching article headings in the same order, each located by searching forward from the previous heading so that ordering is enforced rather than assumed. 113 is CONFIRMED. For contrast, the SUPERSEDED 2021 consolidation of the same instrument (also fetched this pass, IFRs Regulations- Final Arabic.pdf) has 111 articles, ending at "المادة الحادية عشرة بعد المئة" -- so the count genuinely moved and 113 is specific to the current text.

STRUCTURE: 9 أبواب, none subdivided into فصول. The 113 articles additionally sit alongside 14 ملاحق (annexes) which are NOT ingested by this track -- see known_unresolved_discrepancies.

TEXT EXTRACTION -- WHY A CUSTOM EXTRACTOR WAS NECESSARY, AND WHY IT DOES NOT ALTER THE TEXT. This PDF stores its glyphs in VISUAL order and embeds subsets of SakkalMajalla / SakkalMajalla-Bold whose ligature glyphs carry CORRECT multi-character ToUnicode mappings ('لا', 'لم', 'لح', 'لخ', 'لمح', 'يج', 'ين', 'تح', ...). `pdftotext` performs its bidi reordering at the CHARACTER level and therefore reverses the interior of every ligature, producing the well-known corruption seen in some other CMA-derived material ("اململكة" for "المملكة", "متهيدية" for "تمهيدية", "املصاحل" for "المصالح", "خالف" for "خلاف"). Rather than repair that corruption after the fact with a word list -- which requires judgement calls and can silently change legal text -- this pass avoided producing it: glyphs were read with pdfminer (which exposes each glyph's own ToUnicode string), grouped into physical lines by baseline, ordered left-to-right by x-coordinate, reversed at the GLYPH level so ligature strings stay internally intact, and then contiguous left-to-right runs (Latin, digits and their embedded neutral punctuation) were re-reversed so numbers, dates and URLs read correctly. This is a pure reordering of glyphs the PDF itself supplies: no character is invented, dropped, substituted, transliterated or spell-corrected, and no word list, dictionary or language model is consulted anywhere in the pipeline.

EXTRACTION VERIFIED THREE WAYS: (1) a rendered page image (pdftoppm, page 9 at 130 dpi) was read back and compared against the extracted text for that page -- they match; (2) the whole corpus was scanned for the twelve characteristic ligature-corruption artefacts listed above -- zero occurrences, the only hits for the string "خالف" being the genuine Arabic words مخالفة/مخالفات/المخالفة; (3) every one of the 113 article bodies was scanned for Latin characters, Arabic presentation-form codepoints, stray bidi control characters, leaked page furniture and leaked structural headings -- zero findings.

AMENDMENT CROSS-CHECK. The consolidated PDF carries NO per-article amendment footnotes, so per-article attribution cannot be read off the primary source. For the most recent amendment it was nevertheless possible to confirm incorporation VERBATIM: the official gazette (جريدة أم القرى) text of CMA Board Resolution (1-135-2025), dated 03/06/1447H, substitutes the phrase «فئات المستثمرين المؤهلين في السوق الموازية» for «فئات المستثمرين المؤهلين» in paragraph (ع) of Article 48 and paragraph (ك) of Article 49 of this regulation. Both substituted phrases were then located, verbatim and in exactly those paragraphs, in the primary PDF ingested here. Those two articles -- and only those two -- are therefore flagged معدلة with the amending instrument cited. The gazette text was obtained through secondary reproductions (press reporting of the أم القرى publication) and through search-result reproduction of the أم القرى page; uqn.gov.sa itself is a JavaScript-rendered site that returned no article text to this client, and laws.boe.gov.sa is hard-blocked (TLS connection reset). That is why this track is TIER_2 and not TIER_1.

MEANING OF "اصلية" IN THIS TRACK -- IMPORTANT. 111 of the 113 articles are recorded as اصلية. That does NOT assert the article is unchanged since 2006. It asserts only that NO article-level amendment could be attributed to it from any artefact actually fetched this pass. The instrument has been repeatedly amended over roughly twenty years and its entire text was REPLACED in 2021 (Resolution 2021-22-2), so the current wording of most articles is materially younger than 2006. Consumers needing per-article amendment provenance must not read "اصلية" as evidence of continuity. See known_unresolved_discrepancies.

VERIFICATION TIER: TIER_2. One OFFICIAL primary source supplies the complete verbatim Arabic text (CMA's own consolidated PDF, corroborated by two further CMA-published artefacts -- the regulations catalogue card and the details.aspx?code=99 page -- and by a superseded CMA PDF of the same instrument that independently corroborates the amendment lineage). The most recent amendment's wording is cross-checked against a SECONDARY reproduction of the official gazette. It is NOT TIER_1: the complete text could not be obtained from a second INDEPENDENT official publisher (uqn.gov.sa served no text to this client; laws.boe.gov.sa is hard-blocked; Wayback and r.jina.ai are blocked), and the CMA catalogue/detail pages are the same issuer as the PDF, not an independent source. It is not TIER_3 or TIER_4 because the governing text itself is entirely primary-official and complete, with no per-article gaps and no mixed-confidence portions.

ENGLISH WAS NOT USED. No English text of this instrument was consulted, downloaded or relied upon at any point. CMA publishes no English PDF for this instrument at the sibling URL (Investment_Funds_Regulations_11_2025_EN.pdf returns HTTP 404) and its detail page links only the Arabic file. Nothing in this track is translated, reconstructed from English, summarised or paraphrased.

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: The regulation ships 14 ملاحق (annexes) after Article 113 -- الملحق 1 متطلبات شروط وأحكام الصندوق; 2 محتويات طلب طرح وحدات صندوق عام; 3 محتويات تقارير الصندوق; 4 محتويات البيان ربع السنوي; 5 طرق تقييم الصناديق العامة; 6 إشعار الطرح الخاص للهيئة; 7 و 8 إقرار الصندوق للهيئة (خاص / أجنبي); 9 البيان الواجب تضمينه في مستندات الطرح الخاص; 10 طلبات الموافقة والإشعارات المقدمة إلى الهيئة; 11 متطلبات شروط وأحكام الصندوق الخاص; 12 صيغة خطاب المستشار القانوني; 13 صيغة خطاب مدير الصندوق; 14 تقرير إنهاء الصندوق. They occupy roughly pages 111-181 of the PDF and are legally operative (numerous articles incorporate them by reference). They are NOT ingested by this track, which covers the 113 numbered articles only. Their headings above were read off the document's own table of contents and are recorded here so the omission is explicit rather than silent. Several annexes are laid out as multi-column tables, which the line-based extractor used here is not appropriate for; ingesting them requires a table-aware pass and should be a separate, clearly-scoped build.

The instrument has been amended repeatedly since 2006 and the CURRENT consolidated PDF carries NO per-article amendment footnotes, so article-level attribution is impossible from the primary source. The amending instruments that could be confirmed from artefacts actually fetched are: (a) 2006-219-1, 3/12/1427H = 24/12/2006G, original issuance [current PDF cover]; (b) 2016-61-1, 16/8/1437H = 23/5/2016G [named on the cover of CMA's superseded 2021 PDF of this same instrument]; (c) 2021-22-2, 12/7/1442H = 24/2/2021G, which REPLACED the entire text, effective 19/09/1442H = 01/05/2021G with phased provisions from 28/5/1443H = 1/1/2022G and 8/6/1444H = 1/1/2023G [superseded 2021 PDF cover]; (d) 2025-54-1, 23/11/1446H = 21/5/2025G [cited inside the gazette text of decision 1-135-2025]; (e) 2025-135-1, 03/06/1447H = 24/11/2025G, the latest [current PDF cover + gazette]. ONLY (e) could be mapped to specific articles (48 and 49). For (b), (c) and (d) NO article-level mapping was obtainable, and NO pre-amendment wording was recovered for any article. Further amendments may exist between 2021 and 2025 that no fetched artefact names -- CMA's current cover prints only the original issuance and the most recent amendment, so the cover cannot be treated as an exhaustive amendment history. Nothing was guessed: articles other than 48 and 49 carry an EMPTY amendment history, which records absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.

111 of 113 articles carry legal_status_ar = اصلية. In this track that value means only 'no article-level amendment could be attributed from the sources fetched'. It does NOT mean the article's wording is unchanged since the 2006 issuance -- the entire text was replaced in 2021 by Resolution 2021-22-2, so most current wording postdates 2006 substantially. This is a deliberate, disclosed limitation of the four-value status vocabulary used across this corpus, not a claim about the articles' legislative history.

The PDF cover gives the latest amendment as 1447/06/03H = 2025/11/24G, while CMA's own details.aspx?code=99 page shows 'تاريخ التعديل 2025/11/26'. The two-day difference is most plausibly decision date versus publication/site-update date (the PDF's own file CreationDate is 2025-11-25), but this pass did not obtain an artefact that states which is which. The Hijri date 03/06/1447 and its stated Gregorian equivalent 24/11/2025 are taken from the instrument's own cover and are what this track records; the 2025/11/26 site figure is recorded here rather than reconciled by assumption.

The official-gazette wording of decision 1-135-2025 (the substitution of «فئات المستثمرين المؤهلين في السوق الموازية» for «فئات المستثمرين المؤهلين») was obtained from secondary reproductions of the أم القرى publication, not from uqn.gov.sa directly: uqn.gov.sa is JavaScript-rendered and served no article text to this client, laws.boe.gov.sa is hard-blocked (TLS reset), and Wayback and r.jina.ai are blocked. The substitution itself was nevertheless confirmed against the PRIMARY text -- both substituted phrases occur verbatim in Article 48(ع) and Article 49(ك) of the CMA PDF. This is the specific reason the track is assigned TIER_2 rather than TIER_1, and it is why Articles 48 and 49 are the ONLY articles flagged معدلة.

Article bodies preserve the PDF's own physical line breaks rather than being reflowed into paragraphs. This was chosen deliberately: reflowing requires deciding where a paragraph ends, which is a judgement about the text. Consumers who want paragraph-level text should join lines themselves. No line was merged, split, reordered or dropped, other than removal of the page furniture (the running footer 'Internal - داخ ل' and bare page numbers), which is not part of the enacted text.

The published text is internally inconsistent about which percent sign it uses, and this track preserves that inconsistency rather than normalising it. U+0025 '%' occurs 47 times across 19 articles (15, 41, 44, 48, 49, 53, 54, 56, 58, 59, 60, 77, 82, 92, 93, 98, 99, 100, 107) while U+066A '٪' (ARABIC PERCENT SIGN) occurs 31 times across 8 others. The split is not semantic: Article 44(أ) and Article 97(أ) are parallel provisions with the same (5) threshold, and they use different codepoints. This was confirmed to be a property of the PDF's own character stream, not of the extractor, by independently reading the same passages out of pdftotext. Separately, every digit in the instrument is a WESTERN digit (U+0030-0039) in the character stream even though the PDF renders them as Arabic-Indic numerals; that is Word numeral-shaping at the font level, and the underlying characters are what this track records. Consumers doing exact string or regex matching on percentages must handle both codepoints. The validator pins the inventory so that a future 'cleanup' cannot silently rewrite the enacted text.

Five in-word tatweel (kashida, U+0640) characters survive in the ingested text -- Article 2 «بـالكلمات»; Article 95 «وفقــاً» and «الملحـق»; Article 110 «نظـام» and «ولوائحـه». They are NOT an extraction artefact: they are present in the PDF's own text stream and are seen independently by pdftotext, which finds the same in-word kashida sequences. They are ordinary Word justification stretching in the published document. They are PRESERVED rather than stripped, because stripping them would edit the enacted text, and this corpus does not edit text to make it tidier. Consumers doing exact string matching against other renderings of this regulation should normalise U+0640 out on both sides before comparing. The validator pins the exact inventory (article 2: 1, article 95: 2, article 110: 2) so that any future drift is caught rather than absorbed.

Every body page of the source PDF carries the non-legislative running footer 'Internal - داخ ل' (an internal-classification watermark). It extracts with a space inside the word داخل because the two halves are drawn as separate positioned runs in the PDF. The footer is page furniture, not enacted text; it is stripped from every article body and appears nowhere in this track's records. It is noted only so that anyone re-running the extraction against the raw PDF is not surprised by it.
